note: Refreshes store-surface provenance against the current official Apple and Google Play requirements and adds records for Apple's current required iPhone and iPad display classes. The existing Play, iPhone alternate, and 12.9-inch accepted-size rows keep their stable ids.

surfaces.name: Google Play feature graphic
surfaces.authority: Google Play Console Help — Add preview assets to showcase your app (https://support.google.com/googleplay/android-developer/answer/9866151); feature graphic is required at exactly 1024x500 pixels, JPEG or 24-bit PNG without alpha.

surfaces.name: Google Play phone screenshot
surfaces.authority: Google Play Console Help — Add preview assets to showcase your app (https://support.google.com/googleplay/android-developer/answer/9866151); 1080x1920 is within the 320–3840 pixel side limits and is 9:16 portrait.

surfaces.name: Google Play tablet screenshot
surfaces.authority: Google Play Console Help — Add preview assets to showcase your app (https://support.google.com/googleplay/android-developer/answer/9866151); 1920x1080 is within the 1080–7680 pixel large-screen range and is 16:9 landscape.

surfaces.name: App Store 6.7-inch screenshot
surfaces.authority: Apple App Store Connect Help — Screenshot specifications (https://developer.apple.com/help/app-store-connect/reference/app-information/screenshot-specifications/); 1290x2796 portrait is an accepted screenshot size for iPhone with Dynamic Island (large display).

surfaces.name: App Store 6.5-inch screenshot
surfaces.authority: Apple App Store Connect Help — Screenshot specifications (https://developer.apple.com/help/app-store-connect/reference/app-information/screenshot-specifications/); 1284x2778 portrait is an accepted screenshot size for iPhone with Face ID (large display).

surfaces.name: App Store 12.9-inch accepted screenshot size
surfaces.authority: Apple App Store Connect Help — Screenshot specifications (https://developer.apple.com/help/app-store-connect/reference/app-information/screenshot-specifications/); 2048x2732 portrait is accepted for the 13-inch iPad display and the legacy 12.9-inch display.

surfaces.name: App Store iPhone Dynamic Island medium-display screenshot
surfaces.authority: Apple App Store Connect Help — Screenshot specifications (https://developer.apple.com/help/app-store-connect/reference/app-information/screenshot-specifications/); iPhone with Dynamic Island (medium display) is required and accepts 1206x2622 portrait or 2622x1206 landscape.

surfaces.name: App Store iPad 13-inch display screenshot
surfaces.authority: Apple App Store Connect Help — Screenshot specifications (https://developer.apple.com/help/app-store-connect/reference/app-information/screenshot-specifications/); 13-inch iPad display is required for iPadOS apps and accepts 2064x2752 portrait or 2752x2064 landscape.
